payload.name: pc-classify-value
payload.description: Classify an optional raw value while preserving the distinction between missing and null. Reads a raw candidate from inputs.get('value'). Returns {state:'missing',value:null} when the key is absent; {state:'null',value:null} when the value is present but null; {state:'value',value:<original>} when the value is an exact integer in 0..10 inclusive (booleans and floats are rejected); and {state:'invalid',value:null} for any other value. No defaults, no coercion, no exceptions, no imports, no host calls and no I/O. Pure logic; assigns result on every outcome.
